Is Sound Club Samui open in 2026? | Yes. It promoted guest-DJ nights throughout 2026, and its next listed event is ESSENCE on Wednesday 4 November 2026 from 21:00 to 03:00. Older directories that call it permanently closed refer to an earlier club of the same name.
What are Sound Club Samui's opening hours? | Listings give 22:00 until late every night, with some directories saying up to 06:00; event nights are advertised from 21:00 or 22:30 to 03:00. It is quiet until about 01:00 and busiest after 02:00.
How much is entry to Sound Club Samui? | On 2026 event nights women usually got in free and men paid 300–500 THB including one drink; a few nights were free for everyone. Prices depend on the DJ, so check the live listing on this page.
What music does Sound Club Samui play? | Techno, house and underground electronic music on event nights, with Thai and international guest DJs, and club hits and remixes on regular nights. Its sound system is the main draw, so bring ear plugs.
Which nights are best at Sound Club Samui? | Wednesday, Friday and Saturday, when it has usually run guest-DJ event nights in 2026. Whatever the night, arrive after 01:00.
How far is Sound Club from the Green Mango Club? | About 60 m: both are on Soi Green Mango in central Chaweng, with the Green Mango Club at the beach end of the lane. Many people start at Green Mango and move to Sound Club after 02:00.
How much do drinks cost at Sound Club Samui? | Cocktails cost about 300 THB, and reviewers note that water and soft drinks cost almost as much as alcohol. Bring cash and check prices at the bar.
What should I wear to Sound Club Samui? | Smart casual is the safe choice. Beachwear and flip-flops may be turned away, and you need ID showing you are 20 or over; a laminated passport copy works better than a phone photo.
How do I get back to Lamai or Bophut from Sound Club? | Grab costs about 200–400 THB late at night but has fewer drivers after 03:00, and taxis on Chaweng Beach Road quote fixed fares, so agree the price first. We can book a pre-agreed 03:00 or 04:00 pickup on WhatsApp. Don't ride a scooter after drinking: police run checkpoints in Chaweng.
